cohort: The study included 20 dyads of parents and their children aged 3-12 years, diagnosed with Autism Spectrum Disorder and behavioral difficulties, recruited from a tertiary hospital's autism care program.
finding: The telehealth-delivered group parent training program demonstrated feasibility and moderate acceptability, leading to significant improvements in child behavior (irritability, lethargy, hyperactivity) and caregiver quality of life, although the reduction in parental stress was not sustained over time.
